detail.longDescription: I built it because it's very hard to keep up with all the new CVEs coming out. The main problem is I don't know which ones apply to my computer, projects or our infra. So I built pantry to make it easier to figure out what actually needs to be patched, if it even can be, and how to do it quickly. It has lots of features so I think it would be helpful for other people so we just open sourced it as my first product at my new AI co because we're using it internally to secure some of our agentic runtimes and our own infra.
